label: EU-dsa-2022 Article 44

obligations.text: The Commission shall consult the Board, and shall support and promote the development and implementation of voluntary standards set by relevant European and international standardisation bodies, at least in respect of the following:
The Commission shall support the update of the standards in the light of technological developments and the behaviour of the recipients of the services in question.
The relevant information regarding the update of the standards shall be publicly available and easily accessible.
